title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site update
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts for Python/TypeScript SDKs; updated docs site with new quickstart pages, code samples, and a RAG templates gallery. No breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and concise tool-calling quickstarts so developers can onboard to agent patterns quickly. This PR adds a small curated set of templates (search-backed QA, calendar assistant, ticket triage) plus language-specific quickstarts for Python and TypeScript that demonstrate model selection, tool registration, and robust error handling. The change also updates the docs site: new quickstart pages, a templates gallery, and a cross-reference in the agents reference page. Checklist: [x] RAG templates added under redwood-examples/rag/templates, [x] Python quickstart and README, [x] TypeScript quickstart and README, [x] docs site pages and redirects, [x] unit and integration tests for examples, [x] CI green. Related: Linear ENG-1043, PM-332. Notes: examples use the Redwood SDK public API; all secrets are placeholders and clearly documented. No infra or runtime changes included.
commits: c1a8f4d: add initial rag agent templates (search-qa, calendar, ticket-triage)
d2b9e11: add python quickstart and unit tests for examples

diff_snippets:
search-qa.yaml:  tool_bindings:
    - name: search
      type: http
      url: https://search.example/api
    pipeline:
      - retrieve
      - rerank
      - generate

example.py:  from redwood import Client
  client = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
  agent = client.agents.create(template="search-qa")
  response = agent.run("How do I reset my password?")
